comment: Independent C-first hero-to-monster AD_ELEC entry point. A debug Wizard uses controlled polymorph into an electric eel, then creates a hostile newt. Fifteen source-page dismissals clear the eel form's overburden message and automatic quarterstaff drop; the two adjacent eel bites miss once and then land. The landed second bite reaches damageum -> mhitm_adtyping -> mhitm_ad_elec -> zap.c:destroy_items. This is distinct from the monster-to-monster grid-bug/newt recipe.
